mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( UNION ALL UNION ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'REPLAY_START' AS kind,r.id AS object_id,NULL AS version_id,NULL AS revision, s.started_at AS occurred_at,CONCAT('REPLAY_START:',r.id) AS evidence_key FROM review_repractice r JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=r.owner_id AND s.id=r.session_id WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.started_at IS NOT NULL ) candidate

SELECT v.owner_id,v.feedback_id AS id,v.revision,f.revision AS current_revision, f.session_id,f.question_id,f.answer_id,v.created_at, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.kind')) AS kind, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.authorLabel')) AS author_label, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.dimension')) AS dimension, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.coverage')) AS coverage, SHA2(CAST(v.content_json AS BINARY),256) AS content_hash, (JSON_TYPE(CAST(v.content_json AS JSON))='OBJECT' AND JSON_LENGTH(v.content_json)=10 AND OCTET_LENGTH(v.content_json)<=131072 AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.kind'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.authorLabel'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.dimension'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.coverage'))='STRING') AS metadata_valid FROM review_feedback_revision v LEFT JOIN review_feedback f ON f.owner_id=v.owner_id AND f.id=v.feedback_id WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.feedback_id=#{id} AND v.revision=#{revision}

SELECT v.owner_id,v.recollection_id AS id,v.id AS version_id,v.version_number,v.title,v.baseline_kind,v.created_at, r.status,r.revision,r.current_version_id,r.version_number AS head_version_number, current_v.version_number AS actual_current_version_number,v.interview_id,v.interview_revision,v.interview_json, (CHAR_LENGTH(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.answerFragment')))>0) AS has_answer_fragment, (CHAR_LENGTH(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.feedback')))>0) AS has_feedback, (CHAR_LENGTH(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.uncertainty')))>0) AS has_uncertainty, SHA2(CAST(v.content_json AS BINARY),256) AS content_hash, (JSON_TYPE(CAST(v.content_json AS JSON))='OBJECT' AND JSON_LENGTH(v.content_json)=9 AND OCTET_LENGTH(v.content_json)<=196608 AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.title'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.title'))=v.title AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.baselineKind'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.baselineKind'))=v.baseline_kind AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.answerFragment'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.feedback'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.uncertainty'))='STRING') AS metadata_valid FROM review_recollection_version v LEFT JOIN review_recollection r ON r.owner_id=v.owner_id AND r.id=v.recollection_id LEFT JOIN review_recollection_version current_v ON current_v.owner_id=r.owner_id AND current_v.recollection_id=r.id AND current_v.id=r.current_version_id WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.recollection_id=#{id} AND v.id=#{versionId}
mapper.sql: owner_id,id,source_id,revision,comparison_id,repractice_id,answer_id, SHA2(CAST(verification AS BINARY),256) AS verification_hash,outcome,created_at, SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(reason,citations_json) AS BINARY),256) AS content_hash, (CHAR_LENGTH(verification) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND JSON_TYPE(CAST(citations_json AS JSON))='ARRAY' AND JSON_LENGTH(citations_json)<=6 AND OCTET_LENGTH(citations_json)<=32768) AS metadata_valid
mapper.select: SELECT FROM review_source_judgment WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM review_source_judgment WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_id=#{sourceId} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.owner_id,c.id,c.repractice_id,c.session_id,c.question_id,c.answer_id,c.answer_number, a.version_number AS actual_answer_number,s.status AS session_status FROM review_comparison c LEFT JOIN training_answer a ON a.owner_id=c.owner_id AND a.session_id=c.session_id AND a.question_id=c.question_id AND a.id=c.answer_id LEFT JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=c.owner_id AND s.id=c.session_id WHERE c.owner_id=#{owner} AND c.id=#{id}

SELECT owner_id,repractice_id,source_id,action_id,action_revision,position_index AS position, JSON_OBJECT( 'sourceId',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.sourceId'), 'actionId',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.actionId'), 'actionRevision',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.actionRevision'), 'id',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.id'), 'originActionId',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.originActionId'), 'kind',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.kind'), 'sessionId',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.answer.sessionId'), 'questionId',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.answer.questionId'), 'answerId',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.answer.answerId'), 'feedbackId',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.feedbackId'), 'feedbackRevision',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.feedbackRevision'), 'taskId',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.taskId'), 'observationId',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.observationId'), 'recollectionId',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.recollection.recollectionId'), 'recollectionVersionId',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.recollection.versionId'), 'recollectionVersionNumber',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.recollection.versionNumber'), 'recollectionBaselineKind',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.recollection.baselineKind'), 'tracking',JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.tracking')) AS identity_json, SHA2(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.verification')) AS BINARY),256) AS verification_hash, (JSON_TYPE(CAST(snapshot_json AS JSON))='OBJECT' AND OCTET_LENGTH(snapshot_json)<=196608 AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source'))='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.sourceId'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.actionId'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.actionRevision'))='INTEGER' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.id'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.originActionId'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.kind'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.tracking'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.verification'))='STRING' AND CHAR_LENGTH(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.verification'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.kind'))='RECOLLECTION' THEN JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.recollection') = (SELECT CAST(s.recollection_json AS JSON) FROM review_action_source s WHERE s.owner_id=review_repractice_source.owner_id AND s.id=review_repractice_source.source_id) ELSE JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.recollection') IS NULL OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot_json,'$.source.recollection'))='NULL' END) AS metadata_valid FROM review_repractice_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND repractice_id=#{repracticeId} AND source_id=#{sourceId}

SELECT s.owner_id,s.id,s.action_id,s.origin_action_id,s.kind,s.session_id,s.question_id,s.answer_id, s.feedback_id,s.feedback_revision,s.task_id,s.observation_id,s.recollection_id,s.recollection_version_id, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.recollection_json,'$.versionNumber')) AS UNSIGNED) AS recollection_version_number, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.recollection_json,'$.baselineKind')) AS recollection_baseline_kind, SHA2(CAST(s.verification AS BINARY),256) AS verification_hash,s.tracking, a.revision AS action_revision,a.status AS action_status,a.merged_into, (CHAR_LENGTH(s.verification) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND CASE WHEN s.kind='RECOLLECTION' THEN s.session_id IS NULL AND s.question_id IS NULL AND s.answer_id IS NULL AND s.feedback_id IS NULL AND s.feedback_revision IS NULL AND s.task_id IS NULL AND s.observation_id IS NULL AND s.manual_kind IS NULL AND s.author_label IS NULL AND s.observation_json IS NULL AND s.decision_json IS NULL AND JSON_TYPE(CAST(s.recollection_json AS JSON))='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.recollection_json,'$.recollectionId'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.recollection_json,'$.versionId'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.recollection_json,'$.versionNumber'))='INTEGER' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.recollection_json,'$.baselineKind'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.recollection_json,'$.recollectionId'))=s.recollection_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.recollection_json,'$.versionId'))=s.recollection_version_id ELSE s.recollection_id IS NULL AND s.recollection_version_id IS NULL AND s.recollection_json IS NULL END) AS metadata_valid FROM review_action_source s LEFT JOIN review_action a ON a.owner_id=s.owner_id AND a.id=s.action_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.id=#{id}

SELECT r.owner_id,r.id,r.session_id,r.question_id,r.question_mode,s.started_at,s.status AS session_status, s.question_count,q.kind AS question_kind FROM review_repractice r LEFT JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=r.owner_id AND s.id=r.session_id LEFT JOIN training_question q ON q.owner_id=r.owner_id AND q.session_id=r.session_id AND q.id=r.question_id WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.id=#{id}

SELECT s.status FROM training_answer a JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=a.owner_id AND s.id=a.session_id WHERE a.owner_id=#{owner} AND a.session_id=#{sessionId} AND a.question_id=#{questionId} AND a.id=#{answerId}
